query: What happens when Samsung Galaxy S8 buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?
search_text: What happens when buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?

rows.text: Seller Sent a Refurbished Phone Instead - Which We Discovered After the Return Date!. I purchased this phone last year, and it never worked as I wanted. When I contacted Amazon a while back to return it altogether, I was told that it was too late. But recently, it was working poorly enough that I brought it to be fixed. When the cellphone repair company opened the phone, they discovered that this was a refurbished phone, as opposed to a new phone as I thought I had bought. (They said that there were stickers on each part, showing where it had come from.) The fact that it's refurbished is especially problematic as the repair shop said that the main problem is the antenna; and a refurbished antenna is very difficult and expensive to fix/replace. Given this information, I demand a refund from the seller.

Ordered by mistake. I loved the seller, very understanding. REFUNDED my money in a timely manner. I did not use the phone. I believe in dealing with them it would be as advertised. I would not hesitate to use them in the future.

product was defective /Samsung S8 Cell Phone. This was suppose to be a brand new phone and before I even turned it on I charged the battery to 100% charge and disconnected the charger from the phone and I did not turn the phone on until the next morning and it was down to 3% battery so I charged it again and the next morning it was down to 28% charge. I returned the defective phone and got a refund however the seller charged me a $36.00 restocking charge, I could understand that if I returned the phone because I didn't like it or want it but I do not understand why I had to pay a restocking charge for a defective phone. I will never order anything from this seller again. I am very disappointed with the handling of this return.

Thought it was working fine. Been a Samsung user my whole life. Had this phone for about 3 months. Thought it was working fine. Been a Samsung user my whole life. But after the latest update, the phone kept restarting on its own. I called Samsung to see if they can repair it, but the serial number is not in their system. Phone is fake, but looks real. Very upset about this because the seller said they can't do anything about it after the 3 month period. Luckily Amazon was able to help me with the refund. Don't buy from this seller.
Buyer beware. The back came off had to get it replaced

Don't buy, gets broken quick, no warranty. The USB-C port gets broken, is a very common problem with this model, as is an unlocked phone Samsung doesn't provide warranty for it (this is absurd) and the seller doesn't give any warranty either, so, I was rip off, don't let it happen to you.
Defective phone. Phone was defective but by the time we realized, the seller wouldn’t take a return. Also suspect it was refurbished but sold as new.

Wrong info and bad business practice:. The phone is not original which supposed to have Android 7 (Nougat) on it as advertised, some time along the way has been updated to Android 9 (Pie) with locked bootloader, Very disappointed. In addition he does not pay for returning the item and at the end he refuses to refund, I had to let Amazon know of this and finally I was refunded by Amazon not the seller after 2 weeks.

SCAM. SCAM NOT a Verizon phone. Returned to seller. Now they want my Google account and Password. They claim they need it because it is FRP locked. They should be able to bypass using Samsung Bypass Tool. Cost:$164.99 Refund:$1.00 ?
Garbage phone. Do not buy from this buyer! Brand new phones break in 30-60 days after returns are longer accepted what a waste of $600 down the drain never again in my life!

A very bad experience with this seller. A very bad experience with this seller, i order the phone for an unlocked and when i receive it I saw it don't match with my choice... I don't recommend any to this one

A bad experience, ( Not the Phone itself). I returned it to the seller as there were too many issues with the phone. (It kept telling me to activate it through Spectrum) when they were not my selected carrier.

False advertisement, bought through “Chubbiestech”. This phone is supposed to be brand new... IT IS NOT. My cellphone had an old SIM card in it (to bad they didn’t take it out- i wouldn’t have know other wise!). I checked online and the warranty started April 27 2018, witch means its used and no longer has warranty from Samsung. This is not ok! Don’t tell people it is new when it is used! It’s worth at least 100$ less than it said... who can i contact to get a refund? The phone works fine (as far as i know) by the way...
Caution do not buy if you have Verizon or Sprint. Do not buy this phone if you have Verizon or Sprint phone was fine but took them more than 2 weeks to give me a refund very inconvenient

it just started normally like i opened my old phone. i received a used phone. the sticker was torn and when i turned on the phone it didn't started with the setup procedure , it just started normally like i opened my old phone. i don't want to write a bed review about the product because it seems like the phone is good, but make sure if you are buying the international model do it from a certified buyer with a lot of traffic.

So when I bought this phone, it worked well for the first time when tested. after a month(by which return window was closed), I gifted it to my dad, in the first two weeks only it stopped working. I got this phone back to the USA for repairing it (realized it was not under USA warranty) , spent some bucks repaired it, and sent it back to my dad. again after a few weeks, it stopped working and the technician in that country said, the motherboard might be the problem... after all these, my dad bought a new phone for himself. and nothing can be done now. Never buying phones from any seller online.

Worst customer service ever. BUYER BEWARE! Worst customer service ever! My phone wasn't working and when I sent it in to get repaired they told me they had to charge me, even though it was supposed to be under warranty. WILL NEVER BUY SAMSUNG AGAIN!
Buyer beware... you lose certain options when it doesn't have a carrier... Wi-Fi calling is one if them

Your taking a chance if you but a refurbished cell phone on Amazon.... It's a rugged phone. And a refurbished one at that. And it probably would have lasted a lot longer, but nope, it started turning off on its own and would not stay on longer than a few seconds. Until it doesn't stay on any longer... But you'd think that the seller would have put a new battery in it an secured it properly before advertising it as "like new"...

The phone is made in China, not South Korea - and it shows. The phone I received was made in China, not South Korea. It stopped working properly 2 months after I got it. After contacting Samsung (they have international models specialists) and following their instructions trying to fix it, Samsung finally told me that this phone apparently has pre-installed software versions hat is not the one that should be there. Samsung also said that they never heard of this seller. The other Galaxy s8 I bought with this one (from a different seller) luckily just died within 3 weeks and I was able to return it. The return window is only 1 month. Of course. Waste of money, energy and trust.
